use_case: The agent is fixing duplicate push notifications in prod. The cause is an SQS visibility timeout that is shorter than the job's real p99 duration. Several Helm values files use the same key with different values.
situation: The agent read the Helm values for notifier staging, notifier prod and billing-worker prod. All three define queue.visibilityTimeoutSeconds, each with a different value. It also pulled the p99 duration of the notifier job in prod from the metrics.
must_keep: The notifier prod values file sets visibilityTimeoutSeconds to 45 at deploy/helm/notifier/values.prod.yaml. The prod metrics show the send_batch job has a p99 of about 71s.
may_drop: The staging notifier values (300), the billing-worker prod values (180), the chart default of 30, the assistant's hedged guess that prod matches staging, and the build/test/git noise.
why_judges_fail: The staging file and the assistant summary share more words with the goal, and the billing file also has a prod value for the same key. A judge could keep those and drop the short prod notifier block. The agent would then think prod is already at 300, or edit the wrong file, or pick a timeout without knowing the real 71s p99.
